patch_description:
Refactor ANSATZ_SPEC to share parameters across ring CRX gates and hub-edge CRX gates.
- Replace the perimeter CZ gates with CRX gates sharing a single parameter crx_ring.
- Replace the per-edge hub CRX gates with a single shared parameter crx_hub_edge across all hub connections.
This reduces the per-block parameter count from 13 to 11 (11 per block), improving parameter efficiency and potentially aiding training stability and generalization while preserving connectivity and symmetry.
